page.layout: One printed label in the centre of the scan; no running text. Handwriting, library stamps and shelf marks on the cover are not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is the front cover/endpaper of a bound volume, not a title page of the book. The yellow library label reads "BIBLIOTHECA NAZIONALE" with "14 / 11 M / 2" (printed numerals, not transcribed as text). The "III. 13. a" is partly struck through, with "III." printed and "13. a" struck and rewritten. Handwritten pencil and ink marks ("14:7-E-9", "69-3.10", "III 14 C", "II C") are not transcribed as they are manuscript. The label on the cover is set in a smaller serif; the struck-through numeral is shown here without the strike.
